params.caption:
🚨 A third of Firaxis Games' staff is gone.

The Civilization and XCOM studio has laid off around 60 people — about a third of its workforce — and studio head Heather Hazen is departing as part of the cuts, 2K confirms.

2K says Firaxis is restructuring and recentering around the studio's core strength, refocusing on design, technology and player experience to keep setting the strategy genre's standard.

The news lands as Bloomberg reports the studio's next XCOM game has faced development struggles, reportedly missing a significant milestone over the summer.

🕐 Published: 17 Nov 2026, 19:50 GMT+3

📰 Sources: Gematsu, Bloomberg

👥 2K: https://x.com/2K
👥 Firaxis Games: https://x.com/FiraxisGames

💬 Is this smart restructuring, or another sign strategy games are being squeezed? Sound off below 👇
